style_alignment.rationale: Warm plum-brown rock vocabulary sampled from tunnel-interior; chunky 16x16 cells with first-room cyan-crystal ramp; crystal seam reads at 3x against dim tunnel band.

identity_continuity.rationale: First face tile family; establishes cyan-ore vertical seam damage progression for #421 wiring.

questions.question: The four states are ordered unambiguously by damage at native scale.
questions.notes: intact full seam → chipped edge scars → cracked fracture void → crumbling large voids and loose fragments; progression reads left-to-right in composite.

questions.question: Each state remains distinguishable from the other three with hue removed.
questions.notes: Geometry differs: solid seam, edge chips, central fracture, scattered fragments; value patterns do not collapse when desaturated.

questions.question: Each tile repeats vertically with no visible seam.
questions.notes: Row 0 equals row 15 on all four tiles; 3x vertical repeat in 48x112 column shows no horizontal discontinuity.

questions.question: Cyan appears only in crystal Cells; the surrounding rock is not recolored.
questions.notes: Cyan-class pixels confined to seam columns x5-10; rock uses warm plum-brown ramp only.

questions.question: Every tile is exactly 16x16 with no magenta and no anti-aliased edge pixels.
questions.notes: All four PNGs 16x16 RGBA binary alpha; zero magenta and zero semi-transparent pixels.
